owner: Claude (pick-carry-place owner); review: Codex; execution: DeepSeek
commit_before_run: this file (status REGISTERED) + selected P4 checkpoint SHA256 + base case file SHA256 + l2-base-cases-admissibility.json must be committed before any L2 LLM call or rollout

code.execution: scripts/run_warp_flow_teacher.py of this root stack, unchanged; student arm adds --student-eval (worker SHA pinned 3c9337d5)

task.order_sheet: v_l2: one long_beam to zone B, assigned_robot null, no single-robot-impossible flag
task.binding: west/east -> teal/blue grip band by world x of the band (+x = east); written only into case.plan.roles (student role token and teacher end); nothing else in the case changes
task.robot_input: own order sheet + own distances to the two grip bands (source plan_geometry_v1 [대체: perception not wired]) + inbox of the condition channel; never the peer's distances or the band colours

seeds.generator: P3 case generator (same start distribution as P5: each robot 0.3-1.2 m from its generator end) [확인 필요: P3 command fixed by DeepSeek/worker ⑤]
seeds.overlap_check: scripts/check_pairact_r1_seeds.py known_ranges + pairact-r1 train/validation/heldout (8340000-8340199, 8341000-8341019, 8342000-8342019) must not intersect [확인 필요: add the L2 range to seeds.json before run]
seeds.selection_rule: ascending seed order, keep a case iff |cos(beam_yaw)| >= 0.5 (harness/e2e_l2.case_admissible), take the first 6; static and outcome-free, applied before any LLM call

conditions.secondary_execution: leader_en, structured, no_comm only if GPU night time remains after primary (order fixed: leader_en, structured, no_comm); never pooled
conditions.leader_rule: leader = r1 if seed % 2 == 0 else r2
conditions.rounds: no_comm 1; structured/peer_en min 2 max 3 (stop once ends are distinct after round >= 2); leader_en 2 (assign + ack)
conditions.planner: pinned planner of configs/model_endpoints.json at run time [확인 필요: live planner binding not wired, harness/e2e_l2.planner_ask raises NotImplementedError]

arms.policy: pairact-r1 checkpoint chosen by harness.pairact_r1.select_checkpoint on validation (same as P5)
P2 MJWarp GT pair-carry teacher, same root stack, without --student-eval
arms.label: [대체 단계] teacher, NOT a learned result
arms.use: grade C demo video and reference n/6 only; reported side by side, never merged

episode_cap_sim_s: same value as the registered P5 cap (PAIRACT_R1_EVAL_PREREG_DRAFT.json episode_cap_sim_s rule); [미정 until P5 cap is committed]

success.per_seed: llm.success_eligible AND executed AND carry_success == true AND (student arm) teacher_steps == 0 AND summary.student_eval present
success.llm_success_eligible: both robots need_partner == true, both chose an end, ends distinct, no named error (L2_SOLO_DECISION, L2_DUPLICATE_END, L2_INVALID_*, L2_MESSAGE_INVALID, L2_LEADER_*)
success.carry_success: unchanged GT evaluator of the root runner: placed in zone B AND drop_events == 0 AND robot_robot_contacts == 0
success.not_executed: a seed whose LLM stage is not success_eligible is not rolled out and counts as failure in N=6
success.assignment_match: measured (decided ends == generator ends), NOT a success term: a swapped but distinct assignment is executed as decided
success.claim: primary: student peer_en n/6. Minimum L2 claim (replan §6) = >= 1/6 student success in peer_en or another condition, each condition reported separately

llm_stage: hallucination_n (heuristic: foreign end name, ungrounded distance; Codex re-annotates)
execution: student funnel (approach, alignment, READY, grasp, hold_3s, carry_1m, door, place)
metrics.report: per condition and per arm n/6, same seed order; LLM-stage metrics also reported for conditions not executed

exclusions.pre_run: only case_admissible (east/west) and the P0 static stance-feasibility check registered for P5, both applied before any LLM call
exclusions.host_error: one rerun of the same seed with the SAME recorded LLM decision (no second LLM call); a second HOST_ERROR counts as failure and is reported separately
exclusions.llm_retry: forbidden; a transport error is recorded as L2_NO_DECISION failure [확인 필요: whether the live planner retries internally]

compute_estimate.llm: 4 conditions x 6 seeds x <= 6 calls, < 0.1 USD at pinned prices [확인 필요: token counts]
compute_estimate.gpu_h: about 0.6-1 per condition-arm of 6 worlds (P5 estimate 2-3 GPU-h per 20) [확인 필요]
compute_estimate.window: off-peak only (UTC 16:30-00:30), gcp6 or gcp2, stop VM after

replay_mode: scripts/run_e2e_l2.py --llm replay is for dry runs/tests only and is never reported as a result
